content.value_statement: Mascot concepts often become detailed illustrations that fail at small sizes. This skill creates simple, product-relevant logo directions with consistent generation constraints.
actual_capabilities: Infers mascot directions from product documentation or a supplied brand brief.
Proposes three distinct directions before image generation.
Plans six labeled candidates across selected directions.
Builds generator-aware prompts with concise visual constraints.
Checks outputs for silhouette, color, composition, and background compliance.
Reports candidate paths, dimensions, prompts, colors, and remaining deviations.
limitations: Requires an available image-generation tool to produce visual assets.
Cannot guarantee exact color counts or geometry from every image model.
Focuses on square mascot marks, not typography or complete brand systems.
Image model limits may reduce the requested resolution.

use_cases.title: Launch an App Mascot
use_cases.description: Turn a product brief into three relevant mascot directions and six comparable square candidates.

use_cases.title: Explore Brand Characters
use_cases.description: Test distinct treatments of one chosen subject while preserving shared colors and complexity limits.

use_cases.title: Standardize Logo Generation
use_cases.description: Apply repeatable prompts and evaluation rules across mascot experiments for multiple products.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Mascot
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a rounded [subject] mascot logo for [product]. Use [background color] and keep the design readable at small sizes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a named subject and basic product context.

prompt_templates.title: Propose Product Directions
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the available product context for [product]. Propose three distinct mascot directions, then ask approval before generating six candidates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Discover mascot concepts from an existing product repository.

prompt_templates.title: Develop One Direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the selected [subject] direction. Generate six controlled variants with different silhouettes, secondary color regions, and personality emphasis.
prompt_templates.scenario: Explore one approved concept without changing the core subject.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Constrained Brand Study
prompt_templates.prompt: Create six independent candidates for [brand brief]. Preserve [required cues] and [palette]. Evaluate every result against the skill rules and report deviations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Produce and assess a controlled advanced design study.

output_examples.input: Create a mascot logo for a friendly password manager.
output_examples.output: Three directions: a shield ghost for quiet protection, a key turtle for durable security, and a vault robot for dependable access.

output_examples.input: Generate six variants of the approved ghost direction.
output: A1-A6: six separate square assets with controlled silhouette and personality changes.
Each result includes its saved path, dimensions, color mapping, prompt, background mode, and evaluation notes.

output_examples.input: Use coral and teal backgrounds for a gardening application.
output_examples.output: The batch reserves coral and teal for backgrounds, chooses two separate plant colors, and checks contrast for each candidate.

best_practices: Provide the product purpose, audience, and intended personality.
Name any required mascot subject, brand cues, or background colors.
Review all six candidates together before requesting detailed refinement.
anti_patterns: Do not request a contact sheet when separate full-resolution assets are needed.
Do not add detailed anatomy, textures, labels, or decorative fragments.
Do not claim exact compliance without inspecting every generated result.

faq.question: Does this skill generate the images?
faq.answer: Yes, when the agent has a configured image-generation tool. Otherwise, it asks the user to enable or provide one.

faq.question: How many concepts does it propose?
faq.answer: It proposes three directions and recommends six independent candidates. Users can request a different quantity or distribution.

faq.question: Can I specify the mascot subject?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill keeps that subject and proposes three distinct treatments based on shape, composition, color regions, or personality.

faq.question: Can I provide brand colors?
faq.answer: Yes. Supplied background colors remain reserved for backgrounds unless the user assigns them differently.

faq.question: What image format does it target?
faq.answer: It targets separate square assets near 1536 pixels. It preserves lower native resolutions when the image service imposes a limit.

faq.question: Does it create complete brand identities?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on simplified mascot marks and does not create typography systems, brand guidelines, or trademark clearance.
